descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you well-organized and detail-oriented? Do you have a high client service orientation and risk awareness? We’re looking for someone who is ready to perform the following tasks:

• client's account opening and maintenance
• launch investigations, prepare documents, provide information, and compose correspondence with stakeholders
• interact with client relationship teams and other front and middle office teams
